name: Credit Markets
description: Corporate bonds, leveraged loans, CDS, and securitized credit: spreads, defaults, and ratings.

metrics.name: oas
metrics.description: Option-adjusted spread over the risk-free curve

metrics.name: cs01
metrics.description: Value change for a one-basis-point spread widening

metrics.name: default_rate
metrics.description: Issuers defaulting in the period divided by issuers at the start

metrics.name: market_value
metrics.description: Market value outstanding at a point in time

conventions.rule: Report spread moves in basis points; widening is a positive change.
State whether default rates are issuer-weighted or dollar-weighted and over what horizon.
Map ratings to one scale before comparing across agencies.

insight_rules.reason: Spread is market-value-weighted; attribute via CS01 times spread change.

caveats.text: Index-level spreads move when index composition changes at rebalances, not only when credit changes.

chart_conventions.rule: Order ratings from highest to lowest quality, not alphabetically.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
